name: GlobalLeaks Directory Refresh

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 2 AM UTC
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  refresh-globaleaks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Fetch and process GlobalLeaks data
        env:
          GLOBALEAKS_DATA_URL: ${{ secrets.GLOBALEAKS_DATA_URL }}
          GLOBALEAKS_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GLOBALEAKS_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python scripts/fetch_globaleaks_data.py
          python scripts/normalize_globaleaks_data.py

      - name: Validate normalized data
        run: |
          python scripts/validate_globaleaks_data.py

      - name: Update directory JSON
        run: |
          python scripts/update_directory_json.py

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add data/globaleaks_instances.json data/directory.json
          git commit -m "Update GlobalLeaks directory data" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:main || echo "Push failed, likely no changes"

  test-globaleaks:
    needs: refresh-globaleaks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest tests/test_globaleaks_directory.py -v

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install flake8 black

      - name: Lint with flake8
        run: |
          flake8 .

      - name: Format with black
        run: |
          black --check .
